question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a public Plugin SDK reply-payload contract, or remain an internal Codex-to-Slack delivery detail?
rationale: The PR adds third-party-visible exports and semantics; repository policy treats Plugin SDK expansion as compatibility-sensitive, and the permanent API boundary cannot be safely inferred from this Slack bug fix alone.

options.title: Keep the generic SDK contract
options.body: Approve the additive marker, but require whole-payload Slack handling, compatibility coverage, and exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry the intent through an internal or owner-specific seam while retaining the Slack fix.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive marker, but require whole-payload Slack handling, compatibility coverage, and exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the native-data Slack delivery path that must consume the contract correctly.
